edits.rationale: CDK5 activity supports survival in RB1-null neural-lineage cells; CDK5-scope drugs should show enhanced effect where RB1 is lost.
edits.applicability: Lines with RB1 mutation, measured by DNA panel.

edits.rationale: Co-occurring PIK3CA activation and PTEN loss create compounded PI3K-pathway dependence, predicting deeper response to PI3K inhibitors than either lesion alone.

edits.distinguishing_prediction: PIK3CA+PTEN double-mutant lines should be more sensitive to PI3K inhibitors than single-lesion lines.

edits.rationale: APC/TP53-mutant colorectal cells show chromatin remodeling and HDAC dependence; HDAC inhibition is expected to be more effective in this background.
edits.applicability: Lines with both APC and TP53 mutations; binary gate.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: APC+TP53 double-mutant lines should respond more to HDAC inhibitors than single-mutant lines.

edits.rationale: APC loss with KRAS activation drives MAPK-pathway addiction in colorectal cancer; MEK inhibition should be more effective in this co-mutant subset.
edits.applicability: Lines with both APC and KRAS mutations; binary gate.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: APC+KRAS double-mutant lines should be more sensitive to MEK inhibitors than KRAS-only lines, improving MEK-inhibitor hit nomination.

edits.applicability: Lines with TP53 mutation and high measured belinostat (BRD-K17743125) response; state = belinostat probe core times TP53-mutant gate.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: On held-out esophagus/soft-tissue lines, PDGFRA-scope drugs show lower viability where belinostat probe response is more negative and TP53 is mutant, beyond the base model.

edits.applicability: All lines; state is the continuous measured I-BET-762 (BRD-K08109215) probe response.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: SCN5A-scope drugs are more potent in held-out lines that are more sensitive to I-BET-762, with the effect concentrated in the esophagus project.

edits.rationale: IMPDH1 residual is strong across all support (t_all -2.44) and project (-4.08); CDK-inhibitor sensitivity marks proliferative, nucleotide-demanding lines that depend on IMPDH for GTP supply.
edits.applicability: All lines; state is the continuous measured PHA-793887 (BRD-K64800655) probe response.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: IMPDH1-scope drugs show greater sensitivity in held-out lines with more negative PHA-793887 probe response.

edits.rationale: INSR residual is supported across all data (t_all -2.33); Aurora-inhibitor sensitivity combined with PIK3CA mutation marks mitotic-fragile, PI3K-addicted lines where INSR/IGF1R signaling is a survival dependency.
edits.applicability: Lines with PIK3CA mutation and high measured MLN-8054 (BRD-K83963101) response; state = Aurora probe core times PIK3CA-mutant gate.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: INSR-scope drugs are more potent in held-out PIK3CA-mutant lines that are more Aurora-inhibitor sensitive.

edits.rationale: p38 inhibitors respond less in JAK2-mutant lines (t_all +2.44, t_project +3.56); JAK2-driven STAT signaling bypasses p38 stress-apoptosis dependence, buffering p38 blockade.
edits.applicability: Lines carrying JAK2 mutation (binary DNA-panel gate).
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out JAK2-mutant lines are less sensitive to p38 MAPK inhibitors than the base model predicts.

edits.rationale: IMPDH2 residual is protective where both TP53 and PIK3CA are mutated (t_all +2.25, t_project +3.55); combined loss of p53 checkpoint and PI3K-driven nucleotide synthesis reduces reliance on IMPDH2 flux.
edits.applicability: Lines mutant for both TP53 and PIK3CA (binary DNA-panel gate).
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out TP53/PIK3CA double-mutant lines are less sensitive to IMPDH2-scope drugs than predicted.

edits.rationale: Residual shows CDK inhibitors are more potent in TP53-mutant lines that are also globally sensitive (low b); TP53 loss removes G1/S checkpoint and RB-dependent CDK4/6 activity becomes the dominant proliferative driver, so combining intrinsic sensitivity with TP53 loss should sharpen CDK-inhibitor response.
edits.applicability: Lines with TP53 mutation, weighted by the line's inferred overall sensitivity offset b (more negative b = stronger effect).
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Among TP53-mutant held-out lines, CDK-inhibitor drugs should show progressively lower viability as b becomes more negative, whereas TP53-wildtype lines show no b-dependence.

edits.rationale: Residual for BRAF-targeting drugs tracks the global sensitivity offset b, consistent with BRAF inhibitors acting partly through the MAPK-addicted proliferative state that b captures; a continuous b term should generalize better than a binary mutation gate.
edits.applicability: All lines, effect scaled by inferred overall sensitivity offset b.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out lines with more negative b should respond more strongly to BRAF-targeting drugs, independent of BRAF mutation status.

edits.rationale: CDK9 (PTEFb) drives transcriptional elongation and is co-targeted by BET bromodomain inhibition; lines intrinsically sensitive to the BET probe I-BET-762 should also be more sensitive to CDK9-directed drugs because both collapse oncogenic transcription.
edits.applicability: All lines, effect scaled by measured response to probe BRD-K08109215 (I-BET-762); more negative probe response = stronger effect.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out lines with more negative I-BET-762 probe response should show greater sensitivity to CDK9-targeting drugs.

edits.rationale: OPRM1-scoped drugs co-cluster with HSP90 inhibition; lines sensitive to the HSP inhibitor BIIB021 have destabilized client kinases and should be more responsive to OPRM1-directed agents, reflecting shared proteostatic vulnerability.
edits.applicability: All lines, effect scaled by measured response to probe BRD-K51967704 (BIIB021); more negative probe response = stronger effect.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out lines with more negative BIIB021 probe response should show greater sensitivity to OPRM1-scoped drugs.

edits.rationale: Residual indicates calcium-channel-blocker response is amplified in TP53-mutant lines that are also MEK-inhibitor sensitive; TP53 loss plus MAPK-pathway dependence may lower apoptotic threshold, making calcium-channel blockade more cytotoxic.
edits.applicability: TP53-mutant lines, effect scaled by measured response to probe BRD-K26667523 (TAK-733); more negative probe response = stronger effect.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Among TP53-mutant held-out lines, calcium-channel-blocker sensitivity should increase with more negative TAK-733 probe response, with no such trend in TP53-wildtype lines.

edits.rationale: HDAC5-scoped drugs are more potent in lines that are TP53-wildtype and PIK3CA-wildtype; intact p53 and PI3K signaling may create a dependency on HDAC5-mediated chromatin remodeling that is lost when either pathway is mutated.
edits.applicability: Lines wildtype for both TP53 and PIK3CA.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out TP53-wildtype/PIK3CA-wildtype lines should be more sensitive to HDAC5-scoped drugs than lines carrying either mutation.

edits.rationale: Residual cluster shows FGFR4-directed drugs are more potent in APC-mutant lines; APC loss rewires Wnt/cadherin signaling and has been linked to altered FGFR dependency, so APC mutation should mark a context-specific FGFR4 vulnerability.
edits.applicability: Lines carrying an APC mutation in the DNA panel; measured as mut:APC binary.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: On held-out APC-mutant lines, FGFR4-scope drugs show lower viability than the base model predicts; APC-wildtype lines show no shift.

edits.rationale: Parallel residual cluster for FGFR2 with the same APC gate; APC-mutant colorectal-type lines may depend on FGFR2 bypass signaling, giving a conditional sensitivity not captured by the base model.
edits.applicability: Lines with mut:APC in the panel.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: FGFR2-scope drugs are more potent specifically in APC-mutant held-out lines; effect absent in APC-wildtype lines.

edits.rationale: Residual shows less sensitivity to FGFR4 drugs where the HSP90 probe response is high and APC is mutant; HSP90 client stabilization (including FGFR kinases) can buffer FGFR4 inhibition, so this interaction should be protective.
edits.applicability: APC-mutant lines with high measured response to the HSP inhibitor probe BRD-K51967704 (continuous probe atom gated by mut:APC).
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Among APC-mutant held-out lines, those more sensitive to BRD-K51967704 respond less to FGFR4-scope drugs than predicted; no such modulation in APC-wildtype lines.

edits.rationale: Residual shows less FGFR2 sensitivity where HDAC-probe response is high and APC is mutant; HDAC inhibition can upregulate RTK/FGFR compensatory signaling, blunting FGFR2 blockade in this genotype.
edits.applicability: APC-mutant lines with high measured response to the HDAC inhibitor probe BRD-K17743125.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: APC-mutant held-out lines with strong BRD-K17743125 response show reduced FGFR2-drug potency relative to model; APC-wildtype lines unaffected.

edits.rationale: EGFR-mutant lung lines with concurrent TP53 loss typically show impaired apoptosis and altered drug response; conditioning EGFR-inhibitor sensitivity on dual EGFR/TP53 status sharpens the existing EGFR seed program for the lung project.
edits.applicability: Lines mutant for both EGFR and TP53 in the panel.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Dual EGFR/TP53-mutant held-out lines are more sensitive to EGFR-inhibitor-scope drugs than EGFR-only mutants; single-mutant lines show no extra shift.

edits.rationale: MDM inhibitors act through p53; TP53-wildtype lines that also retain CDKN2A have intact p53/CDK4-RB arrest machinery and should be the strongest responders, refining the existing protective TP53 seed into a positive conditional program.
edits.applicability: Lines wildtype for TP53 and mutant for CDKN2A (andnot gate).
edits.distinguishing_prediction: TP53-WT/CDKN2A-mutant held-out lines respond more to MDM-inhibitor-scope drugs than other genotypes; TP53-mutant lines remain non-responsive.

edits.rationale: SMARCB1 (INI1/SNF5) loss defines rhabdoid tumors and de-represses RTK/MAPK signaling; FGFR-pathway inhibition should be selectively toxic in SMARCB1-null lines. Strongest coherent residual cluster across FGFR1-4, KDR, PDGFRA/B, FLT1.
edits.applicability: Lines with SMARCB1 mutation/loss on the DNA panel (rhabdoid, mesothelioma, soft-tissue lineages); state measured as binary mut:SMARCB1.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out SMARCB1-mutant lines show lower viability (extra sensitisation) to FGFR-inhibitor-scope drugs than SMARCB1-wildtype lines, beyond the base model.

edits.rationale: FGFR2 is the top-ranked residual (t~-5) with SMARCB1; SWI/SNF loss relieves chromatin repression at RTK loci, making FGFR2-addicted lines exquisitely sensitive to FGFR2-targeting drugs.
edits.applicability: SMARCB1-mutant lines; state binary mut:SMARCB1.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: FGFR2-scope drugs nominate SMARCB1-mutant held-out lines as strong responders; effect absent in SMARCB1-WT.

edits.rationale: SMAD4 loss co-occurs with KRAS/BRAF-driven colorectal and pancreatic tumors; in already-sensitive lines (low b) SMAD4 loss further sensitises to MEK inhibition via loss of TGF-beta growth-suppressive brake.
edits.applicability: SMAD4-mutant lines, effect scaled by the line's inferred sensitivity offset b (continuous).
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Among SMAD4-mutant lines, the most overall-sensitive (lowest b) show the largest extra MEK-inhibitor response; SMAD4-WT lines unaffected.

edits.rationale: HSP90 inhibition (BIIB021) collapses mutant clients including SMAD4-pathway and RAF/MEK components; lines that are HSP-inhibitor-sensitive (low probe response) with SMAD4 loss are predicted to be relatively less responsive to MEK inhibition, reflecting shared downstream dependency.
edits.applicability: SMAD4-mutant lines weighted by measured BIIB021 probe response (continuous).
edits.distinguishing_prediction: SMAD4-mutant lines with strong HSP-inhibitor sensitivity show attenuated MEK-inhibitor response (higher viability) versus SMAD4-mutant HSP-insensitive lines.

edits.rationale: TP53-mutant lines that are EGFR-inhibitor-sensitive (low AG-1478 probe response) carry a hyperactive RTK program; OPRM1-scope drugs act as a proxy for this RTK-addicted state, predicting stronger response.
edits.applicability: TP53-mutant lines weighted by measured AG-1478 probe response (continuous).
edits.distinguishing_prediction: TP53-mutant, EGFR-inhibitor-sensitive held-out lines nominate OPRM1-scope drugs as stronger responders than TP53-WT or EGFR-insensitive lines.

edits.rationale: TP53-mutant lines with high HSP-inhibitor sensitivity reflect proteotoxic/chaperone-addicted states; DRD4-scope drugs are predicted to exploit this vulnerability, giving extra response where the HSP probe is low.
edits.applicability: TP53-mutant lines weighted by measured BIIB021 probe response (continuous).
edits.distinguishing_prediction: TP53-mutant, HSP-inhibitor-sensitive held-out lines show lower viability to DRD4-scope drugs than TP53-WT or HSP-insensitive lines.

edits.rationale: HDAC-inhibitor probe sensitivity marks chromatin-relaxed, replication-stressed lines; topoisomerase poisons need active transcription/replication and should hit harder there. Strong project-specific residual (t_project -10.3).
edits.applicability: All development lines with a measured belinostat (BRD-K17743125) core response; state is continuous so no rarity gate.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out lines with more negative belinostat response show lower viability to topoisomerase inhibitors, beyond the base model and beyond the general sensitivity offset b.

edits.rationale: Aurora-kinase probe sensitivity indicates mitotic/DNA-replication vulnerability; RRM inhibitors deplete dNTPs and should synergize in replication-stressed lines. Residual t_project -8.8.
edits.applicability: All lines with measured MLN-8054 (BRD-K83963101) core response; continuous state.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out lines more sensitive to MLN-8054 are more sensitive to ribonucleotide reductase inhibitors (e.g. gemcitabine-class), conditional on b.

edits.rationale: Same mitotic/replication-stress axis at the target level; RRM2 is the dNTP-supply node whose inhibition is potentiated by replication stress. Residual t_project -6.8.
edits.applicability: All lines with measured BRD-K83963101 core response.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: RRM2-directed drugs nominate more strongly on held-out lines with sensitive Aurora-probe response.

edits.applicability: Lines with KRAS mutation in the DNA panel; binary gate, common enough in the lineage panel.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: KRAS-mutant held-out lines show higher viability under EGFR inhibitors than KRAS-WT lines matched on b and lineage.

edits.rationale: KRAS activation downstream of ERBB2 renders ERBB2-directed agents less effective; mirrors the EGFR-inhibitor KRAS resistance program at target level.
edits.applicability: KRAS-mutant lines (DNA panel).
edits.distinguishing_prediction: ERBB2-scope drugs nominate less on KRAS-mutant held-out lines; effect should track the EGFR-inhibitor program.

edits.rationale: Acetylcholine-receptor-modulator probe response tracks a neuroendocrine/secretory phenotype; TYMS-directed antifolates depend on nucleotide demand that co-varies with this state. Residual t_project -5.6.

edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out lines with more negative VU0238429 response are more sensitive to TYMS inhibitors, conditional on b.

edits.rationale: MDM2 inhibitors act downstream of general fitness; intrinsically sensitive lines (low b) should show amplified response, a robust continuous state.

edits.rationale: SMAD4 loss with EGFR-pathway activity may create IGF1R dependency via bypass signaling; conditional on both signals.

edits.applicability: Lines with SMAD4 mutation (binary DNA panel).

edits.applicability: SMAD4-mutant lines; effect scales with measured Aurora-kinase-inhibitor probe response (BRD-K83963101, already in design).

edits.rationale: Residual cluster indicates HTR3A response scales with Aurora-inhibitor sensitivity specifically in SMAD4-mutant background, suggesting a mitotic/serotonergic interaction.

edits.rationale: Residual cluster shows strong project-specific sensitising effect in TP53-intact/SMAD4-intact lines, consistent with p53-dependent apoptotic competence.

edits.applicability: Lines with a CTNNB1 activating mutation in the DNA panel; measured as binary mut:CTNNB1.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out CTNNB1-mutant lines should show higher viability (less sensitivity) to adrenergic receptor antagonists than CTNNB1-wildtype lines, after accounting for overall sensitivity offset b.

edits.applicability: Lines carrying an ERBB4 mutation in the DNA panel; measured as binary mut:ERBB4.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out ERBB4-mutant lines should be less sensitive to ADRA1D-targeting drugs than ERBB4-wildtype lines.

edits.rationale: Parallel to ADRA1D: ERBB4 mutation associates with reduced sensitivity to ADRA1B antagonism, consistent with ERBB-driven bypass survival. t_all 3.77.
edits.applicability: Lines with ERBB4 mutation; measured as binary mut:ERBB4.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out ERBB4-mutant lines should show reduced response to ADRA1B-targeting drugs relative to wildtype.

edits.applicability: Lines with MLH1 mutation, weighted by measured response to probe BRD-K64800655 (more negative = more sensitive); state = probe value times binary MLH1 gate.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Among MLH1-mutant held-out lines, those more sensitive to the CDK probe should be more sensitive to ADRA1B-targeting drugs; no such slope in MLH1-wildtype lines.

edits.rationale: Continuous CDK-inhibitor probe response predicts CHRM2-antagonist sensitivity, linking proliferative/CDK dependency to cholinergic-receptor antagonist response. t_all -1.52, t_project -5.32.
edits.applicability: All lines, weighted by measured response to probe BRD-K64800655 (continuous).
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out lines more sensitive to the CDK probe should be more sensitive to CHRM2-targeting drugs, with a monotone slope across the probe range.

edits.rationale: In TP53-mutant lines, greater sensitivity to the EGFR probe (tyrphostin-AG-1478) predicts reduced HDAC3-inhibitor response, consistent with EGFR-addicted TP53-null cells relying less on HDAC3. t_project 5.66.
edits.applicability: Lines with TP53 mutation, weighted by measured response to probe BRD-K68336408; state = probe value times binary TP53 gate.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Among TP53-mutant held-out lines, those more sensitive to the EGFR probe should be less sensitive to HDAC3-targeting drugs; slope absent in TP53-wildtype lines.

edits.rationale: CDKN2A loss plus high bromodomain-inhibitor sensitivity marks a BCL2-dependent, apoptosis-primed state; BCL inhibitors should then lower viability further.

edits.applicability: Lines with CDKN2A mutation and high measured sensitivity to tyrphostin-AG-1478 (probe BRD-K68336408).
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out CDKN2A-mutant, EGFR-inhibitor-sensitive lines should show greater NFkB-inhibitor response than lines lacking either feature.

edits.applicability: Lines with CDKN2A mutation and high measured sensitivity to TAK-733 (probe BRD-K26667523).
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out CDKN2A-mutant, MEK-inhibitor-sensitive lines should respond more to p38 MAPK inhibitors than CDKN2A-wildtype or MEK-resistant lines.

edits.rationale: TP53-mutant lines with high HDAC-inhibitor sensitivity are apoptosis-dysregulated; XIAP targeting should preferentially sensitise them.
edits.applicability: Lines with TP53 mutation and high measured sensitivity to belinostat (probe BRD-K17743125).
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out TP53-mutant, belinostat-sensitive lines should respond more to XIAP-targeting drugs than TP53-wildtype or belinostat-resistant lines.

edits.rationale: CDKN2A-intact, CTNNB1-wildtype lines retain apoptotic priming and are less dependent on BCL2, so BCL2-targeting drugs should be less effective there.
edits.applicability: Lines without CDKN2A mutation and without CTNNB1 mutation.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out CDKN2A-intact/CTNNB1-wildtype lines should be less sensitive to BCL2-targeting drugs than lines with either alteration.

edits.rationale: High bromodomain-inhibitor sensitivity marks a chromatin/transcriptional state in which ATP1A1-targeting drugs are less effective, possibly via compensatory ion-transport and survival programs.

edits.rationale: RB1-deficient cells shift IGF1R/IRS signaling and are less dependent on IGF1R; high b marks generally sensitive lines where this buffering is visible.
edits.applicability: Lines with RB1 mutation and high b.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: IGF1R-scoped drugs are less potent on held-out RB1-mutant high-b lines.

edits.rationale: PTEN loss with high BET-inhibitor sensitivity (BRD-K08109215 probe) marks a chromatin/RTK state where CSF1R blockade is less effective.
edits.applicability: Lines mutant for PTEN with high measured response to the BET probe BRD-K08109215.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out PTEN-mutant lines sensitive to BET inhibition respond less to CSF1R-scoped drugs.

edits.rationale: PTEN-intact, RB1-wildtype lines retain RTK/PI3K feedback control and are more dependent on tyrosine kinase signaling, so broad PTK inhibitors hit harder.
edits.applicability: Lines wildtype for PTEN and RB1.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out PTEN/RB1-wildtype lines show lower viability under protein tyrosine kinase inhibitors than the base model predicts.

edits.rationale: PTEN/STK11-intact lines retain cholinergic growth signaling; loss of either buffers the anti-proliferative effect of muscarinic antagonism.
edits.applicability: Lines wildtype for PTEN and STK11.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out PTEN/STK11-wildtype lines are more sensitive to acetylcholine receptor antagonists.

edits.rationale: MEK inhibitors are most effective in RAS/BRAF-driven tumors; lines lacking KRAS and PIK3CA mutations retain MAPK dependency and should respond more, while KRAS-mutant lines have bypass/feedback resistance.
edits.applicability: Cell lines with no KRAS mutation and no PIK3CA mutation (binary DNA panel), measured on all development lines.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out lines that are KRAS-wildtype and PIK3CA-wildtype should show lower viability to MEK inhibitors than lines with either mutation, beyond the base model.

edits.rationale: PI3K inhibitors act where PI3K/AKT signaling is intact; PTEN loss and KRAS mutation provide redundant survival signaling that blunts PI3K inhibition, so double-wildtype lines should be more sensitive.
edits.applicability: Lines wildtype for both PTEN and KRAS on the DNA panel.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: PTEN/KRAS double-wildtype held-out lines should be more sensitive to PI3K inhibitors than lines carrying either mutation.

edits.rationale: EGFR blockade depends on EGFR-addicted signaling; downstream KRAS or BRAF mutations bypass EGFR and confer resistance, so EGFR-wildtype-downstream lines respond more.
edits.applicability: Lines without KRAS or BRAF mutation on the DNA panel.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: KRAS/BRAF double-wildtype held-out lines should show greater sensitivity to EGFR inhibitors than mutant lines.

edits.rationale: CDK4/6 inhibition requires intact RB1 and is potentiated by CDKN2A loss (p16 loss releases CDK4/6); RB1-mutant lines are resistant, so RB1-wildtype lines with CDKN2A loss should respond most.
edits.applicability: Lines wildtype for RB1 and mutant for CDKN2A on the DNA panel.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: RB1-wildtype/CDKN2A-mutant held-out lines should be more sensitive to CDK inhibitors than RB1-mutant lines.

edits.rationale: MDM2 inhibitors require wildtype p53 to induce apoptosis; TP53 mutation abolishes response, and ATM loss impairs p53 activation, so TP53/ATM wildtype lines should respond more.
edits.applicability: Lines wildtype for TP53 and ATM on the DNA panel.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: TP53/ATM double-wildtype held-out lines should show greater sensitivity to MDM inhibitors than lines with either mutation.

edits.rationale: BCL-2 inhibition triggers apoptosis that is potentiated by intact p53 and by CDKN2A loss (p16 loss increases apoptotic priming); TP53-mutant lines are protected.
edits.applicability: Lines wildtype for TP53 and mutant for CDKN2A on the DNA panel.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: TP53-wildtype/CDKN2A-mutant held-out lines should be more sensitive to BCL inhibitors than TP53-mutant lines.

edits.rationale: Residual cluster shows sodium channel blocker drugs more potent where JAK2-mutant lines have a more negative overall sensitivity offset; JAK2 mutation may co-occur with lineage-specific ion-channel dependence in esophagus.
edits.applicability: Lines with JAK2 mutation; effect scales with the line's inferred sensitivity offset b (more negative b = stronger effect).
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out JAK2-mutant lines with more negative b should show lower viability under sodium channel blockers than the base model predicts, improving hit ranking.

edits.rationale: p38 MAPK inhibitors show a project-specific residual where JAK2-mutant, generally sensitive lines respond more; JAK/STAT and p38 stress signaling cross-talk.
edits.applicability: Lines with JAK2 mutation, weighted by b.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: JAK2-mutant held-out lines with negative b should be more sensitive to p38 inhibitors than predicted.

edits.rationale: SCN5A-targeting drugs show the strongest project residual with the same JAK2 x b state; voltage-gated sodium channel expression is lineage-dependent and may track JAK2-mutant sensitivity.
edits.applicability: Lines with JAK2 mutation, weighted by b.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: SCN5A-scope drugs should nominate JAK2-mutant, b-negative held-out lines more strongly.

edits.rationale: ALK-directed drugs are less effective in lines lacking PIK3CA but carrying JAK2 mutation, consistent with bypass PI3K/JAK survival signaling.
edits.applicability: Lines PIK3CA-wildtype and JAK2-mutant.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out PIK3CA-WT/JAK2-mutant lines should be less sensitive to ALK inhibitors than the base model predicts.

edits.rationale: PDGFRA-scope response scales with HDAC-inhibitor sensitivity (belinostat probe) specifically in TP53-mutant lines; HDAC activity modulates PDGFR signaling and TP53 loss permits that dependency.
edits.applicability: TP53-mutant lines, weighted by measured belinostat response (more negative probe = stronger).
edits.distinguishing_prediction: TP53-mutant held-out lines that are belinostat-sensitive should show greater PDGFRA-drug sensitivity than predicted.

edits.rationale: IMPDH1-scope drugs respond more where the line is already CDK-inhibitor sensitive (PHA-793887 probe), reflecting shared nucleotide-synthesis/proliferation dependency.
edits.applicability: All lines, weighted by measured CDK-inhibitor probe response.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out lines with strong CDK-inhibitor sensitivity should be more sensitive to IMPDH1 drugs than the base model predicts.

edits.rationale: Residual cluster shows CDK inhibitors more potent where overall sensitivity offset b is low (more sensitive) and TP53 is mutant; TP53 loss relieves G1/S checkpoint and increases reliance on CDK-driven S-phase entry, so combining intrinsic sensitivity with TP53 loss should sharpen nomination of strong CDK responders.
edits.applicability: Lines with TP53 mutation; state magnitude scales with the line's inferred sensitivity offset b (more negative b = more sensitive).
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Among TP53-mutant held-out lines, CDK-inhibitor viability should be lower in lines with more negative b, beyond what the base model and the existing moa:CDK inhibitor|mut:RB1 program predict.

edits.rationale: HDAC5 residual is consistently protective where b is low and RB1 is mutant; RB1 loss plus high overall sensitivity may shift cells toward HDAC5-independent transcriptional states, reducing response to HDAC5-targeting drugs.
edits.applicability: Lines with RB1 mutation; effect scales with b (more negative b = stronger protection).
edits.distinguishing_prediction: In RB1-mutant held-out lines, HDAC5-scope drugs should show higher viability (less response) in lines with more negative b than the base model predicts.

edits.rationale: HDAC5 residual is sensitising in TP53-wildtype, CDKN2A-wildtype lines; intact p53/CDKN2A checkpoint with HDAC5 inhibition may push cells toward apoptosis, whereas loss of either checkpoint blunts this.
edits.applicability: Lines wildtype for TP53 and CDKN2A (binary gate).
edits.distinguishing_prediction: HDAC5-scope drugs should be more potent in held-out lines that are TP53-WT and CDKN2A-WT relative to lines carrying either mutation, after base-model adjustment.

edits.rationale: CDK9 (P-TEFb) inhibition is synthetically lethal with BET bromodomain inhibition; lines intrinsically sensitive to the BET probe I-BET-762 should respond more to CDK9-targeting drugs.
edits.applicability: All lines; state is the measured response to probe BRD-K08109215 (I-BET-762), more negative = more sensitive.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: CDK9-scope drugs should show lower viability in held-out lines that are more sensitive to I-BET-762, beyond base-model prediction.

edits.rationale: Residual links OPRM1-scope response to HSP90-inhibitor probe sensitivity; HSP90 client stabilization broadly affects kinase/GPCR signaling, so lines sensitive to BIIB021 may be more responsive to OPRM1-targeting agents.
edits.applicability: All lines; state is measured response to probe BRD-K51967704 (BIIB021), more negative = more sensitive.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: OPRM1-scope drugs should be more potent in held-out lines that are more sensitive to BIIB021, beyond base-model prediction.

edits.rationale: Residual shows calcium-channel-blocker response scales with MEK-inhibitor probe sensitivity specifically in TP53-mutant lines; TP53 loss may couple calcium/MEK signaling to survival, making these lines more vulnerable to calcium channel blockade.
edits.applicability: Lines with TP53 mutation; effect scales with measured response to probe BRD-K26667523 (TAK-733), more negative = more sensitive.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Among TP53-mutant held-out lines, calcium-channel-blocker drugs should show lower viability in lines more sensitive to TAK-733, beyond base-model prediction.

edits.rationale: Residual cluster shows FGFR2-scoped drugs more potent in APC-wild-type, PIK3CA-wild-type lines; loss of APC and activating PIK3CA both engage bypass/feedback survival signaling that blunts FGFR dependence, so their absence leaves FGFR2 as the dominant driver.
edits.applicability: Lines with wild-type APC and wild-type PIK3CA (DNA panel), measured by mut:APC=0 and mut:PIK3CA=0.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out APC-WT/PIK3CA-WT lines should be more sensitive to FGFR2-targeting drugs than APC-mutant or PIK3CA-mutant lines, improving hit ranking over the base model.

edits.rationale: FGFR1 residual is strongest in APC-WT/KRAS-WT lines; KRAS activation provides parallel MAPK drive that overrides FGFR1 blockade, and APC loss perturbs the same growth-factor context, so dual wild-type status marks FGFR1-addicted lines.
edits.applicability: Lines with wild-type APC and wild-type KRAS (DNA panel).
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out APC-WT/KRAS-WT lines should show greater FGFR1-inhibitor sensitivity than lines carrying either mutation.

edits.rationale: FGFR4 residual is sensitising in APC-WT/FBXW7-WT lines; FBXW7 loss stabilizes oncoproteins (e.g. MYC, NOTCH) that supply alternative proliferation signals, and APC loss activates Wnt, both reducing reliance on FGFR4.
edits.applicability: Lines with wild-type APC and wild-type FBXW7 (DNA panel).
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out APC-WT/FBXW7-WT lines should be more sensitive to FGFR4-directed drugs than mutant counterparts.

edits.rationale: Pan-FGFR inhibitor residual mirrors the FGFR1/2 pattern: KRAS-mutant lines have constitutive downstream MAPK flux that bypasses FGFR blockade, and APC-mutant lines shift to Wnt-driven growth, so dual wild-type status predicts FGFR-inhibitor response.
edits.applicability: Lines with wild-type APC and wild-type KRAS (DNA panel).
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out APC-WT/KRAS-WT lines should respond more to FGFR inhibitors than lines with either mutation, raising hit yield for this MoA.

edits.rationale: PPARA residual is sensitising and scales with overall sensitivity offset b in RB1-mutant lines; RB1 loss deregulates E2F and lipid/oxidative metabolism, making RB1-mutant, generally-sensitive lines disproportionately dependent on PPARA-driven fatty-acid oxidation.
edits.applicability: RB1-mutant lines (mut:RB1=1), with effect magnitude proportional to the line's inferred sensitivity offset b.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Among RB1-mutant held-out lines, those with more negative b should be more sensitive to PPARA agonists, producing a steeper response slope than in RB1-WT lines.

edits.rationale: TGFBR1 residual is protective and scales with measured BRD4-inhibitor response in KRAS-mutant lines; KRAS-mutant lines with high BET-inhibitor sensitivity have rewired chromatin/TGF-beta crosstalk, buffering them against TGFBR1 blockade.
edits.applicability: KRAS-mutant lines (mut:KRAS=1), with effect proportional to the line's measured response to probe BRD-K08109215 (I-BET-762).
edits.distinguishing_prediction: KRAS-mutant held-out lines that are more sensitive to I-BET-762 should be less sensitive to TGFBR1 inhibitors, reversing the naive expectation and improving ranking.

edits.applicability: Lines carrying SMARCB1 mutation (DNA panel), enriched in rhabdoid/soft-tissue lineages; measured as binary mut:SMARCB1.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out SMARCB1-mutant lines should show lower viability (extra sensitivity) to FGFR-inhibitor drugs than SMARCB1-wildtype lines, beyond the base model and beyond the existing FGFR seed programs.
edits.rationale: Residual cluster shows strong, consistent FGFR-inhibitor sensitivity where SMARCB1 is mutated; SMARCB1 loss deregulates RTK signaling and may create FGFR-pathway dependency.

edits.applicability: Lines with SMARCB1 mutation; state is binary mut:SMARCB1 from the DNA panel.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: FGFR2-targeting drugs should be more potent specifically in SMARCB1-mutant held-out lines; the effect should track the mutation rather than lineage alone.
edits.rationale: Same SMARCB1-loss RTK dependency, at the target level; residual support is strong (t_all -5.0).

edits.applicability: SMARCB1-mutant lines; binary mutation state.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: PDGFRA-directed drugs should show extra sensitivity in SMARCB1-mutant held-out lines relative to wildtype, consistent across lineages.
edits.rationale: SMARCB1-mutant residual sensitivity extends across RTK targets (PDGFRA, KDR, FLT1, PDGFRB), suggesting a shared RTK-dependency program.

edits.applicability: SMARCB1-mutant lines; binary mutation state.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: VEGFR-inhibitor drugs should be more active in SMARCB1-mutant held-out lines than in wildtype lines matched for lineage.
edits.rationale: Residual cluster for VEGFR inhibitors with SMARCB1 is strong and consistent (t_all -3.8, t_project -3.9), supporting an RTK-inhibitor class effect.

edits.applicability: SMARCB1-mutant lines; binary mutation state.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: KDR-targeting drugs should show extra sensitivity in SMARCB1-mutant held-out lines, mirroring the VEGFR-inhibitor class effect.
edits.rationale: KDR (VEGFR2) is the primary VEGFR-inhibitor target; residual support is strong and consistent with the class-level cluster.

edits.applicability: SMARCB1-mutant lines; binary mutation state.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: FLT1-targeting drugs should be more potent in SMARCB1-mutant held-out lines than wildtype, with the effect not explained by lineage.
edits.rationale: FLT1 residual cluster is strong (t_all -3.7, t_project -3.8) and fits the SMARCB1 RTK-dependency pattern.

HDAC-inhibitor probe response marks chromatin-decondensed, replication-stressed lines; topoisomerase poisons trap cleavage complexes and should hit these harder. Strongest residual cluster with consistent sign across all lines.
edits.applicability: All lines; state is the line's measured response to belinostat (HDAC inhibitor) in the fixed 8-well design, already measured on every line.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out lines with more negative belinostat probe response should show lower viability to topoisomerase inhibitors than the base model predicts; the effect should be absent for non-topoisomerase scopes.

edits.rationale: Aurora-kinase probe sensitivity marks mitotic/missegregation-prone lines; RRM2 (ribonucleotide reductase) inhibition depletes dNTPs and should be more lethal in such proliferative, replication-stressed lines.
edits.applicability: All lines; state is the measured response to MLN-8054 (Aurora kinase inhibitor) in the fixed design.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out lines more sensitive to MLN-8054 should be disproportionately sensitive to RRM2-directed drugs (e.g. ribonucleotide reductase inhibitors) beyond the base model.

edits.rationale: dNTP depletion plus Aurora-probe sensitivity should be most toxic in TP53-mutant lines that cannot arrest for repair; combines a continuous mitotic-stress marker with a binary DNA-damage-response gate.
edits.applicability: TP53-mutant lines only; magnitude scaled by the line's MLN-8054 probe response.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Among TP53-mutant held-out lines, those with more negative Aurora-probe response should show the largest extra sensitivity to ribonucleotide reductase inhibitors; TP53-wildtype lines should show no such scaling.

edits.rationale: PTEN loss drives PI3K/AKT-dependent cyclin D-CDK4/6 activity; lines with strong acetylcholine-receptor-modulator probe response (a proliferation/chromatin proxy) and PTEN loss should be more CDK6-dependent.
edits.applicability: PTEN-mutant lines only; magnitude scaled by the line's VU0238429 probe response.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: PTEN-mutant held-out lines with more negative VU0238429 probe response should be more sensitive to CDK6-directed drugs; PTEN-wildtype lines should not show this scaling.

edits.rationale: IMPDH inhibition depletes guanine nucleotides and blocks proliferation; lines already primed toward mitotic catastrophe (Aurora-probe sensitive) should respond more.
edits.applicability: All lines; state is the measured MLN-8054 probe response.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out lines with more negative Aurora-probe response should show greater IMPDH2-inhibitor sensitivity than predicted by the base model.

edits.rationale: RB1 loss releases E2F-driven transcription; lines with high transcriptional output (marked by BET-inhibitor probe sensitivity) and RB1 loss should be more dependent on ongoing RNA polymerase activity.
edits.applicability: RB1-mutant lines only; magnitude scaled by the line's I-BET-762 probe response.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: RB1-mutant held-out lines with more negative I-BET-762 probe response should be more sensitive to RNA polymerase inhibitors; RB1-wildtype lines should show no scaling.

edits.rationale: MDM inhibitors depend on wild-type p53; EGFR-pathway activity (read by the AG-1478 probe) marks lines with intact p53 signaling and higher dependency, so MDM inhibitors should hit harder where the EGFR-inhibitor probe response is more negative.
edits.applicability: All lines; state is the measured response to the design probe tyrphostin-AG-1478 (BRD-K68336408), more negative = more EGFR-inhibitor sensitive.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out lines with more negative AG-1478 probe response show stronger MDM-inhibitor viability loss; the program beats the base model on those lines and shifts nominations toward EGFR-sensitive lines.

edits.rationale: MDM2 inhibitors require functional p53; Aurora-kinase-inhibitor sensitivity (MLN-8054 probe) marks proliferative, p53-competent lines, so MDM2-targeting drugs should be more effective there.
edits.applicability: All lines; state is the measured response to the Aurora kinase inhibitor probe MLN-8054 (BRD-K83963101).
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out lines more sensitive to MLN-8054 show greater MDM2-inhibitor response; program improves prediction and re-ranks nominations toward Aurora-sensitive lines.

edits.rationale: IGF1R drives survival in EGFR-active, SMAD4-intact epithelial tumors; combining EGFR-inhibitor probe sensitivity with SMAD4 wild-type status should identify lines with strong IGF1R dependency.
edits.applicability: Lines with SMAD4 mutation (binary gate) multiplied by the continuous AG-1478 probe response; applies where SMAD4 is wild-type and EGFR signaling is active.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Among SMAD4-wild-type held-out lines, those with more negative AG-1478 probe response respond more to IGF1R-targeting drugs; program improves fit and changes nominations in that subgroup.

edits.rationale: IMPDH inhibitors deplete guanine nucleotides and synergize with proliferative stress; Aurora-kinase-inhibitor sensitivity marks rapidly cycling lines with high IMPDH demand.
edits.applicability: All lines; state is the measured MLN-8054 probe response.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out lines with more negative MLN-8054 probe response show stronger IMPDH1-inhibitor response; program beats base model and shifts nominations toward Aurora-sensitive lines.

edits.rationale: PPAR-alpha agonists depend on lipid-metabolic state; CDKN2A loss releases proliferation and, combined with overall sensitivity offset b, marks lines with high metabolic demand where PPARA modulation bites.
edits.applicability: Lines with CDKN2A mutation (binary gate) multiplied by the continuous overall-sensitivity offset b.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: CDKN2A-mutant held-out lines with more negative b respond more to PPARA-targeting drugs; program improves prediction and re-ranks nominations in that subgroup.

edits.rationale: STK11/LKB1 loss rewires metabolism and reduces AKT dependence; BET-inhibitor probe sensitivity (I-BET-762) marks chromatin state, so AKT inhibitors should be less effective where BET sensitivity is high in STK11-mutant lines.
edits.applicability: Lines with STK11 mutation (binary gate) multiplied by the continuous I-BET-762 probe response.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: STK11-mutant held-out lines with more negative I-BET-762 probe response show weaker AKT-inhibitor response; program improves fit and reduces nominations there.

edits.rationale: MDM2 antagonists require wild-type p53 to stabilize p53 and kill; lines that are TP53-wild-type and lack EGFR-driven bypass should be more sensitive. This is a strong project-specific residual (t_project 7.8) and biologically coherent with the existing protective MDM|mut:TP53 seed.
edits.applicability: Uterus and other lines with wild-type TP53 and wild-type EGFR, measured by DNA panel mut:TP53 and mut:EGFR both absent.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out lines that are TP53-WT/EGFR-WT should show lower viability under MDM inhibitors than the base model predicts, while TP53-mutant or EGFR-mutant lines should not.

edits.rationale: Tubulin-binding agents depend on intact microtubule dynamics and mitotic checkpoints; PTEN/MLH1-intact lines retain tighter mitotic control and DNA-damage surveillance, making them more vulnerable to tubulin destabilization. Strong project residual (t_project -9.81).
edits.applicability: Lines wild-type for PTEN and MLH1 by DNA panel.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Held-out PTEN-WT/MLH1-WT lines should be more sensitive to TUBB-targeting microtubule inhibitors than predicted; PTEN- or MLH1-mutant lines should not show the extra sensitivity.

edits.rationale: Adrenergic antagonism intersects with beta-adrenergic/PKA signaling that cooperates with Wnt/CTNNB1 activation; lines already sensitive to CDK inhibition (PHA-793887 probe) and CTNNB1-mutant should respond more. Strong project residual (t_project -8.14).
edits.applicability: Lines with CTNNB1 mutation and low (sensitive) measured response to probe BRD-K64800655 (PHA-793887).
edits.distinguishing_prediction: Among CTNNB1-mutant held-out lines, those with more negative PHA-793887 probe response should show greater sensitivity to adrenergic antagonists; CTNNB1-WT lines should not.

edits.rationale: ADRA1B signaling couples to Gq/Ca2+ and intersects Wnt/CTNNB1; HDAC-inhibitor-sensitive (belinostat probe) CTNNB1-mutant lines should be more vulnerable to ADRA1B blockade. Strong project residual (t_project -8.32).
edits.applicability: Lines with CTNNB1 mutation and low measured response to probe BRD-K17743125 (belinostat).
edits.distinguishing_prediction: CTNNB1-mutant held-out lines with more negative belinostat probe response should be more sensitive to ADRA1B-targeting drugs; CTNNB1-WT lines should not.

edits.rationale: XIAP antagonism releases caspase activity; RB1-loss lines have deregulated E2F/apoptotic priming, so overall sensitive lines (low b) with RB1 mutation should respond more to XIAP inhibition. Project residual t_project -6.2.
edits.applicability: Lines with RB1 mutation and low inferred overall sensitivity offset b (more sensitive baseline).
edits.distinguishing_prediction: RB1-mutant held-out lines with more negative b should show greater sensitivity to XIAP-targeting agents; RB1-WT lines should not show the b-dependent effect.

edits.rationale: Carbonic anhydrase inhibition perturbs pH regulation that PTEN-loss cells handle poorly due to altered metabolism; overall sensitive (low b) PTEN-mutant lines should respond more. Project residual t_project -6.03.
edits.applicability: Lines with PTEN mutation and low inferred overall sensitivity offset b.
edits.distinguishing_prediction: PTEN-mutant held-out lines with more negative b should be more sensitive to CA2-targeting agents; PTEN-WT lines should not show the b-dependent effect.
